title: Random Effect Every Minute
description: Once You Enter Your World You Will Get A Random Effect Every Minute, Might Be Good Or Bad.
body:
**Once You Enter Your World You Will Get A Random Effect Every Minute, Might Be Good Or Bad.**

**This Mod Might Be Good If You Want To Do A Challenge.**

And You Might Ask, **Does This Mod Impact Performance?**

Not Too Much, Your FPS Will Be 95 instead Of 100 For Example, So Only 5 FPS is Gone

Current Effects : 22

The Effects :
1. Regeneration
2. Resistance
3. Fire Resistance
4. Health Boost
5. Absorption

10. Jump Boost
